name: Tank Run
design_intent:
TRIALS proof course (v3_content_plan PART B; productizes v1_movement_courses.md Course 1 'Tank Run', SIMPLIFIED to a single-screen-scrolling A->B flight run for the mode-system proof — the level-designer authors the full 6-platform 7000px version + the courses 2-3 battery later).

RE-DERIVED against CURRENT Tuning.gd (NOT the stale v1 numbers): trampoline apex 270px, spring 480px, air_drift_max 340px/s, gravity 1600 => zero-boost horizontal reach ~395px off a trampoline / ~527px off a spring. normal_boost_max_speed 760 crosses a ~620px gap in <0.9s at ~24 fuel; a touch refunds +20 (fuel_per_bounce). super_boost_impulse 2800 clears everything.

Layout: a start pad (left) + four tiny trampoline stepping pads over one full-width lethal void + a wide goal pad (right), with a GOAL GATE ring above it. Every gap is 620px = > 527 (max spring drift) and >> 395 (trampoline drift) => FLIGHT-REQUIRED per Rule A: a zero-boost bounce falls ~230px short of the next pad and drops into the void. So the course is impossible without boosting (T3 flight-required gate). Heights vary 960-1120 so the pads read as a run, not a straight line. Falling below the bottom blast line (~1918, derived) rings out -> TrialsMode respawns at the start_gate + adds a +2.0s penalty (NOT an elimination).

MEDAL TIMES (ROUGH — re-derived vs current Tuning; level-designer refines): a clean managed run boosts across 5 gaps (~0.8-1.0s/leg) double-bouncing pads to bank fuel => ~6-8s skilled. gold 9.0 / silver 13.0 / bronze 20.0.
